brief:
An Israeli airstrike struck a tent in Khan Younis, Gaza, killing three people, Al Jazeera English reported. The incident occurred in the southern Gaza city where humanitarian conditions have deteriorated amid the ongoing conflict.

Details about the victims and circumstances surrounding the strike were not immediately available. Khan Younis has been a focal point of Israeli military operations throughout the war in Gaza.

title: Israeli strike kills three in Khan Younis tent
